title: How to Leo Walk (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial: Locking) | Mihran Kirakosian

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down locking steps incrementally with clear verbal counts and physical demonstrations. He emphasizes details like body posture, toe positioning, and arm coordination.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and the leo walk locking step.
Demonstration of the leo walk with music.
Step-by-step breakdown starting with the right knee and side steps.
Slow practice focusing on leg movement and counts.
Adding arm coordination to the footwork.
Practicing the steps with music and counting.

cues: push with the hip a little bit
metaphors: shoot out a little bit with that hip
common_mistakes: not coming up on your toes
safety: keep it just a tiny bit, not too much, you still want to be able to stand straight

steps_taught.name: Leo Walk
steps_taught.description: A locking step involving knee raises, toe pushes, and hip steps side to side.

what_works: breaking down the footwork slowly before adding arms

quotes.text: Today we're going to work on a fun little step called the leo walk.
The first thing we're going to do is we're going to bring up that right knee.
If you never done it, I know the tricky part is kicking that left leg or the right leg out.
It's not as hard as you think it is, guys, you just need to work on it.
